_meta.source: Path of the Fool - Michael Tsarion (2013, Unslaved Media)
_meta.notes: All four suits sourced directly from Tsarion Path of the Fool.

wands.name: Ace of Wands
upright: Dealing with problems assertively and quickly
First step toward new ideas, enterprises, deals and relationships
negative: Struggle to seize the reins of leadership
reversed: A warning to avoid investing energy and resources

wands.name: Two of Wands
upright: Investment in two or more areas
Deciding which of two areas requires attention
reversed: Inability to take on more than one project
Warning not to begin new ventures
Losing sight of needs and goals
Inability to properly bond with others

wands.name: Three of Wands
upright: Involvement with the projects of others
reversed: Refusal to accept help or advice

wands.name: Five of Wands
upright: Making the best of a bad situation
Adding support to a difficult problem
reversed: Long periods of struggle and effort fail to yield positive results
reversed_positive: Refusal to accuse and create enemies

wands.name: Six of Wands
upright: Past successes lead to additional ventures
reversed: Reluctance to be in the center of attention

wands.name: Seven of Wands
negative: Being singled out and made a scapegoat

wands.name: Nine of Wands
reversed: Being compelled to let go and give up

cups.name: Ace of Cups
reversed_positive: Less interest in the welfare of others
More care over personal time and resources

cups.name: Four of Cups
upright: Knowing exactly what we desire and need
Patiently waiting for what we desire
What we desire is before us
negative: Wanting more before we have experienced and understood what is before us
reversed: Not realizing that what we desire is already in front of us
Failure to grasp what is truly required
Resistance to new possibilities or opportunities

cups.name: Eight of Cups
upright: Distancing oneself from a static or negative situation
We prepare to move on and get away
We give no more energy to someone or something
negative: We are completely dissatisfied with results
Taking the safe but wrong road
Making things more difficult for oneself
reversed: The inability to see that our time is being wasted
We are incapable of clear judgment
We walk into projects and relationships of no value

swords.name: Ace of Swords
upright: New patterns of thought and experience
Return to the truth about ourselves

swords.name: Four of Swords
negative: Failure to adjust to new situations
Secret contacts, agreements, pacts, promises and allegiances

swords.name: Nine of Swords
reversed: No change despite experiencing upset or trauma

disks.name: Two of Disks
upright: The early stages of a business with instability overcome slowly
Moving to improved circumstances and financial solvency
Pooling finances or resources with another person
Having enough to spend but economy needed
Signals spending some to get some
Money from more than one source
The application of financial craft and expertise
Learning the ropes as we go
negative: Instability in work, investment or commerce
Ambivalence in terms of the material future
Too many ups and downs, variables and changes
The intervention of the fates and forces outside our personal control
reversed: Slow period of inaction and want
Inability to find alternative strategies and approaches
Lack of resources to advance our fortunes
Advises us to resist speculation and gambling
Given the question and situation, the card can advise us to try different things, to dabble, experiment and strengthen confidence and expertise
We need to become more materially adept
reversed_positive: Termination of a period of upheaval, instability and uncertainty

disks.name: Three of Disks
upright: Advancing a portfolio, proposal, manuscript or resume
Contracts with civic or artistic institutions or organizations
Work rewarding in for its own sake
reversed: Being without real power at work
Being undercut or sabotaged by trusted allies
Our work is copied, plagiarized, or unfairly criticized
Looking for an easy way out
The lowering of personal standards for gain or fame

disks.name: Four of Disks
upright: Material security through work and efficiency
Concrete, careful steps toward the goal
Denotes our home, business and property
Signals calm energies, patience and foresight
Getting our life into complete working order
negative: Can also indicate extreme conservatism and materialism
No sense of play or happiness
"The physical is all there is" mentality
reversed: Loss of power, domestically, financially or even politically
Bad mistakes which have serious consequences to our material wellbeing
Practical disorder, foolishness, haste and impatience
An uneconomical relationship with money leading to waste
Possessing or desiring to possess what does not belong to us, which we have not earned
Occurs when some desired material object is not forthcoming
Being removed from positions of authority and power
Family chaos, losses of wealth and possessions
Shows that we cannot correctly direct our lives on the physical level, due to the lack of maturity, experience, or application
Suggests disempowerment on the psychological level
A warning against premature investment, sales, deals or expansion
Alternatively, depending on the question or situation, the reversed position may suggest that we become more competent and thrifty
reversed_positive: Indicates a loss of faith in competition and materialism
The position tells us to become less retentive and materialistic
We do well to break monotonous routines and take a break from arduous work

disks.name: Five of Disks
upright: Physical and financial hardship and loss
Loss of livelihood, of job or career
Physical exhaustion from meeting material demands
We may find it hard to give of ourselves
Lack of awareness of inner potentials
Physical malady such as illness, toxicity, depression, addiction, poor diet and lifestyle or some negative influence that is in an advanced state
reversed: A period of fear and hopelessness ends

disks.name: Six of Disks
upright: Rewards coming in from a business or enterprise
Time to give ourselves a bonus
Paying back of debts, loans or favors
Taking care of the books and outstanding accounts
Applying for a loan or grant
Indicates allies we may rely on
A good and caring person who seeks to help others in need
reversed: Incapacity in business or in handling money
The illusion of service and success
Inability to correctly apportion time, effort or resources
Failure of discrimination and common sense
Occurs when our material plans and intentions are thwarted or when resources are denied
A negative attitude towards money and the poor
Occurs when we have not had to work for our living or when we are compulsively dishonest in our dealings
A person caring little for the efforts of others and not rewarding confederates and allies
Warning against involvement in communal projects
Resources should be invested with great care or not at all

disks.name: Seven of Disks
upright: We pause and take a needed rest
We recuperate and let things develop on their own for a while
A strong and persistent antipathy toward traditional modes of occupation, career, achievement and trade
We are exhausted with worldly roles and duties
We lack proper power and authority
The search for our true vocation begins
We seek work that allows us to express our true aptitudes and talent
We learn by observing the best
negative: We are not focused on what we are doing
Negative emotions contaminate energy at work
Heavy workload and oppressive responsibilities drain energy
Lack of physical skill or aptitude
Refusal to let go of traditional approaches
Lack of trust in life and inner guidance
reversed_positive: Attention to work-related matters is renewed and fresh
The ending of a fallow period
Termination of a period of doubt and confusion
Gaining a deeper awareness of personal value
Recovering from a period of fatigue and failure
We learn from the past and are grateful for past upsets
Feelings of incompetence and self-doubt fade
We gain confidence and overcome difficult challenges
Our interactions and dealings are conducted professionally and efficiently
We cease being taken advantage of
We refuse to work for useless causes and callous people
Material goals matter and we strive to avoid distractions
Unfinished projects quickly and successfully concluded

disks.name: Eight of Disks
upright: Providing a unique product or service

disks.name: Nine of Disks
upright: Purchasing luxury items and things of value and beauty
Nearing the end of a successful period
reversed: Not enough money for enjoyment and rest
Few good things to enjoy and share
Our interests are purely mundane and superficial

disks.name: Ten of Disks
reversed: Allies lose faith and abandon useless projects
Warning against the launch of material enterprises
